description: Terrain-derived connectivity/corridor defaults. All thresholds are policy parameters and may be recalibrated without changing the generator.

notes.scope: This is physical terrain connectivity, not a vehicle/rail/belt route policy. Mode-specific routing remains downstream.
notes.open_regions: Skeleton lines in very broad open terrain are retained as topology evidence but are not labeled constrained corridors unless clearance is below maximum_constrained_half_width_m.
